prompt: A high-quality illustrated trailhead map panel for a forest loop trail, in the style of a US national park trailhead sign (like the Black Hills or NPS wayside exhibits) but with a Scandinavian / Norwegian design sensibility: warm natural tones, calm and minimal, clean sans-serif typography, a subtle folk-pattern border. Horizontal landscape layout.
